integrity: The proof derives every degree directly from nondegeneracy of the matrix trace pairing, groups vertices by support, and reconstructs the factors from elementary symmetric polynomials. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies a small full graph and independently replays the reconstruction on several larger finite-field products.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats a common finite field and matrix sizes \(n_i\ge2\).
Factors of size one require a modified degree-stratum analysis because nonzero scalars are never self-orthogonal.
The result does not cover arbitrary integral domains or products whose field factors have different orders.
title: Degree distributions reconstruct finite-field factors in product trace graphs
